won.source: Won the title from Tommy Gunn in the pay-per-view's main event, a steel cage match, by pinfall at 28:37.

title: ccw-caliber-1999-world-heavyweight
label: "The Natural" Tommy Gunn

won.source: Recorded from the promotion's own card billing, which frames Gunn as the reigning champion entering the main event.

note: Lost the title to Dazz in a steel cage match after the challenger recovered from a near-fatal fall and hit his finisher.

title: ccw-caliber-1999-x-treme
label: Doctor Pain

won.source: The broadcast's own history recap states Pain became CCW's second X-Treme Champion 'about a month ago' by defeating a wrestler known as The Frankfurter.

note: Lost the title to Reon Wilson inside Hell in a Cell after slipping on blood at the turnbuckle.

won.source: Won the title for a second time from Doctor Pain inside Hell in a Cell by pinfall.

title: ccw-caliber-1999-world-tag-team
label: The Specialists

won.source: The broadcast's own commentary states The Specialists won the belts 'nearly 2 months ago.'

note: Lost the titles to The Dark Alliance after (\/)arcus (\/)agna feigned unconsciousness to steal the pinfall.

won.source: Won the titles from The Specialists by pinfall.

title: ccw-caliber-1999-international
label: "The Bad Boy" Bobby Kamakazee

won.source: Won the tournament final over Dr. MID-Nite to become the first-ever CCW International Champion, after the promotion's own president forced the guest referee to count the fall.

note: The first-ever holder of this title.

title: ccw-caliber-1999-world-television
label: Axl Blaze

won.source: Recorded from the promotion's own card billing as reigning champion entering his defense against Alex Libido.

note: Retained the title against Alex Libido after interference from a rival promotion's own champion.
